checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Translucent washes, soft edges, paper texture.
Clear stone cottage with chimney, windows, door.
Stream with rocks in foreground, in front of the cottage.
Pale green rolling hills behind the cottage.

faults.what: Stream is a pond-like pool in front of the cottage rather than clearly flowing past it; slightly ambiguous
Slightly odd cottage perspective and a faint antenna on the chimney

summary: A charming square watercolour of a stone cottage with green hills and a rocky stream in front, meeting all requirements, with the stream looking somewhat pond-like.
